_readme: Copy to ../config.json (or run `python3 jobradar.py init`) and edit freely. This example is tuned for a Bengaluru-based fintech/payments Product Manager — swap location_filter, title_include, ats_companies, and target_companies for your own city, role, and companies.
_location_note: Substrings matched case-insensitively against each posting's location. Empty list [] disables location filtering entirely (not recommended — the index alone covers ~1.4M postings worldwide).
_sources_note: index = the daily-refreshed multi-ATS index (recommended, always on). ats = the companies list below, queried live (catches postings within minutes, not a day). jobspy = Indeed/LinkedIn scraping via python-jobspy — off by default, read the README before enabling.
_ai_note: backend: 'ollama' (free, local, needs `ollama pull <model>` first — see README for model recommendations), 'anthropic' (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your shell env, never in this file), or 'openai' (needs OPENAI_API_KEY). max_jobs_to_score caps how many postings get a real AI call, ranked by a cheap keyword prescreen first — raise it if you have API budget or patience for a local model. min_score filters the final list.
_target_note: Case-insensitive substring match against company name. Matches are pinned to the top of `scan` results and badged. `watch` alerts specifically on these — every target company needs an entry in ats_companies below, or `watch` will never see it (it polls ats_companies live; it does not re-download the whole daily index on every poll).
_watch_note: `jobradar.py watch` polls ats_companies for postings at your target_companies and never re-alerts on the same URL twice (data/seen_urls.json). auto_tailor: true runs `tailor` automatically the moment a new target-company role appears, so materials are ready when you see the alert. notify.desktop uses a native OS notification (macOS/Linux/Windows, best-effort). notify.webhook_url accepts a Slack or Discord incoming-webhook URL for a more reliable alert than a desktop popup you might miss — leave empty to skip it. `watch` never applies to anything; it only alerts and prepares files.
_ats_companies_note: How to find a company's slug: open its careers page, look at the network tab or page source for 'boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>', 'jobs.lever.co/<slug>', 'jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>', or 'careers.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>'. Or browse https://github.com/kalil0321/ats-scrapers/tree/main/ats-companies for a large pre-built slug dataset (23k+ companies across 8 ATS platforms). Run `python3 jobradar.py verify` after editing this list.
